description: MODIS is a 36-band spectroradiometer measuring visible and infrared radiation. Its bands support observations of vegetation, ocean chlorophyll, clouds, aerosols, fire, snow and sea ice.
facility_description: Aqua is a NASA Earth-observation satellite launched in May 2002 with the second MODIS instrument.
notes: Owner description opened successfully at the NASA Science replacement page. Legacy MODIS page failed on subsequent retrieval and local certificate validation; Ocean Color RSR URL redirected to an Earthdata page returning HTTP 403. Earthdata data-use policy also returned 403, so its search excerpt was not used as licence evidence. NJM includes individual-detector variants; no per-detector mapping or magnitude system is inferred. Curve provenance, applicable terms, acknowledgement and passband/calibration papers remain to verify. | Original-source curves (2026-10-26): Band curves are the equal-weight mean of MCST's per-channel (detector) RSRs, built for NJM (see manifest notes and the recipe tools/recipes/d6_modis.py); MCST publishes per-channel curves only. Bands 1-16 keep NJM's existing names (band645, band859, band469, band555, band1240, band1640, band2130, band412, band443, band488, band531, band551, band667, band678, band748, band869); the earlier SVO copies of NASA OBPG's tables agree with these MCST band averages to <=0.03 % in pivot and become <band>_svo. Bands 17-36 are added as Band17-Band36. DetectorType energy is assumed.
